rival_reading: A program's routine access revision could be entered late; the time mismatch alone does not show a failed evacuation or a minimized response.
gloss: A route revision and a return record carry conflicting times.
title: Revision time predates the order
body: The road revision carries a time earlier than the restriction it repeats. A child's drawing is inside the lunchbox; the only completed box tracks returned forms, not the people listed.

rival_reading: Officials could have collected field supplies during an emergency diversion; the tally does not establish that the program caused the event.
gloss: A plot measurement and delivery record are carried forward with a returned container.
title: Plot total before delivery
body: The plot's water total is copied onto the tally before any delivery time is entered. A worker folded a half-sandwich wrapper into the clipboard; the only signed line confirms the bucket came back.
